credentials.title: Sign in with your Vestel account
credentials.description: Enter the email and password you use in the Vestel Akıllı Yaşam / Evin Aklı app. Home Assistant drives the same login screen the app uses, in the background - nothing else to install.

token.title: Set up with a refresh token
token.description: If automatic login doesn't work for some reason, paste a refresh_token you obtained another way.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong username or password (or the refresh_token is invalid/expired).
error.automation_failed: Automatic login couldn't complete (Vestel's login page may have changed, or there's an extra verification step). Try the "Paste a refresh token" method instead.
error.no_devices: Login succeeded but no AC devices were found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Vestel account is already configured.
